name: Coupling
summary: 60 coupling series in ten families, from miniature servo couplings to grid couplings for mill drives. Choose a family below, or send us the motor power, speed and shaft sizes and we will size it for you.
meta_description: Industrial couplings in ten families: jaw, plum blossom, H-block, gear, pin, tyre, disc, chain, grid, servo and rigid couplings, plus torque limiters and spare elements.
key_features: Ten coupling families from one supplier
Replacement spiders, blocks, sleeves and pins
Interchangeable with common GR, L, HRC, NM, FALK-R and tyre coupling sizes
Sizing support from motor power, speed and shaft sizes
content_html: We supply 60 coupling series in ten families, from miniature servo couplings to grid couplings for mill drives, plus spare elements, torque limiters and pump bell housings. Pick a family below, or send us the motor power, speed and both shaft sizes and we will propose the type and size.
quote_checklist: Coupling type (gear, grid, jaw, disc, tyre) or part number
Driver and driven shaft diameters and keyways
Equipment being coupled and space between shaft ends

families.name: Jaw Coupling
families.tile: Star (spider) jaw couplings in keyed, clamp, taper-bush, expansion-sleeve and flange hubs, with spare spiders.

families.name: Plum Blossom Coupling
families.tile: ML (LM) plum blossom couplings, NM and FALK-R claw couplings, with spare elements.

families.name: H-Block Elastic Coupling
families.tile: HTLA, HTLB and HTLD block couplings, HDS spacer and HTLP brake-disc couplings, with H blocks.

families.name: Gear Coupling
families.tile: NL and TGL nylon-sleeve gear couplings, TGCL all-steel and GIICL drum gear couplings.

families.name: Pin & Bush Coupling
families.tile: ZL pin-and-gear-ring, HL nylon pin, TL and FCL rubber-bush couplings.

families.name: Tyre & Elastic Sleeve Coupling
families.tile: F and UL tyre couplings, Omega split couplings, CFA highly elastic and J/S sleeve couplings.

families.name: Disc Coupling
families.tile: DJM single-disc and SJM double-disc spacer couplings with stainless steel disc packs.

families.name: Chain & Grid Coupling
families.tile: KC and GL roller chain couplings, JS and T10 serpentine grid couplings.

families.name: Servo & Precision Coupling
families.tile: Aluminium jaw, disc, bellows and slit couplings for servo motors, encoders and ball screws.

families.name: Rigid Coupling & Torque Limiter
families.tile: JK clamp-shell rigid couplings, TLC and JTAL torque limiters, pump bell housings and brackets.
